decisions.decision: Build it end to end now. (1) Read the session and enter handling in cloud/src/index.ts (around lines 725 to 761). If no device is recorded per attendee link, add the next-numbered D1 migration: an attendee_devices table (attendee_id, device_hash, first_seen, last_seen, unique on attendee_id plus device_hash) and a nullable attendees.device_cap. Use a long-lived random device cookie, store only its SHA-256, and upsert on /enter and on session use. (2) Add a global device_cap setting (default 20) in settings.ts and Cohort Settings. Add a Devices column and a per-attendee cap override to cloud/admin-ui/admin.js. Flag only: never block, no time locks. (3) Run the probe locally on :8790, apply the remote migration, build and deploy. Verify with a test attendee on two devices, set an override, reload, and confirm the flag. (4) Then retire the local Next admin's device cap with a pointer to the Worker admin. Set status review.
decisions.why: Everything here is on our own systems and buildable. Adi's 2026-10-09 orchestrator-autonomy rule bans asking for step approvals. The no-time-locks rule (2026-10-02) requires flag-only. The deploy and migration commands are documented in [redacted].
